detail.longDescription: Hi, we're White Ravens, a small collective. We self-host the services we use, build a few open-source tools of our own and run game servers for friends. Here we post one self-hosted project a week that we think deserves more users, and we join conversations about self-hosting and homelabs when we have something useful to add. If you run your own stuff too, say hi. We like swapping setups. # selfhosted # opensource # introduction
